# MCP Registry server.json schema, 2025-12-11 (vendored)

`server.schema.json`, unchanged, from
https://static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-12-11/server.schema.json,
copied 2026-10-19. It is part of the Model Context Protocol registry project
(https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry), licensed under the MIT
License and, for new contributions, the Apache License 2.0 (the project's
`LICENSE`).

`runtime/test/listings.test.mjs` validates the `server.json` that
`runtime/scripts/build-host-packages.mjs` builds against it.
